description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Notify the additional Bank Holidays for the purpose of the Act No. 29 of 1971
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice declaring additional bank holidays under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971.
